prompt:
Photorealistic high-fidelity desktop website UI screenshot, 16:9 landscape first viewport of a nightlife discovery homepage. Production product UI, Eventbrite / Resident Advisor / Shotgun class craft, dark nightlife, not a parody, no irony, no quirk.

Exact region order and scale:
1. Slim top navigation bar, full width, ~7% of viewport height. Left: wordmark KONSTANZ in tight white sans-serif. Center-left: text links Discover (active, #CCFF00 neon underline), Explore, Weekend, Saved in #F4F4F5. Right: only a small search icon and a Save/bookmark icon. No Sign in, no Create event, no Tickets, no checkout.
2. Hero block below nav, ~28% of viewport height, generous left padding. Large Discover headline in #F4F4F5, editorial sans, about 48px equivalent. Directly under it a short nightlife-direct line: Plan your nights out in Konstanz. Below that a prominent full-width search field with rounded corners, #18181B fill, subtle inner border, placeholder Search events, venues, nights… and a #CCFF00 search button on the right of the field.
3. Horizontal category chip row, ~8% height. Rounded pills: Student, Party, Club, Bar, Live Music, Culture. One chip (Club) selected with #CCFF00 fill and black type; others #18181B fill with #F4F4F5 type.
4. Featured event card grid filling the remaining lower ~57% of the viewport. Five rounded-corner cards on #18181B with soft shadow elevation, 16px radius, no baked perspective. Each card: large photographic top (club interior, DJ booth, live band, packed dancefloor, bar night — real nightlife photography look), then date, title, venue, price. Cards visible in a 3+2 or 4+1 featured grid: Techno Friday at Blechnerei, Student Night at Club XYZ, Live Music Night at Kulturhaus, House Saturday at Hafenbar, Hip-Hop Party at Bar Central. Dates as weekday night labels. Prices as simple cover like 8 €, 5 €, 12 €, free — not ticket checkout CTAs. No Buy tickets buttons.

Palette locked: page background #0B0B0C, type #F4F4F5, accent #CCFF00, cards #18181B. Materials: rounded cards, hero search, category chips, shadow elevation. Crisp UI screenshot, readable real UI text, Inter or similar geometric sans. No mobile phone chrome, no browser URL bar, no watermarks, no login, no organizer publish, no QR, no fake reviews or sales numbers.
